new_or_changed_insights: OSS-0025 strengthens implementation_fact_to_defect_laundering: explicit sandbox/Wayland compromises with current compatibility blockers are OWNER tradeoffs, not self-authorizing refactors. A post-freeze user report described the shipped Flatpak as working fine and surfaced different concrete issues.

OSS-0027 independently strengthens the same authority boundary in a self-hosted security context: mixed HTTP/HTTPS deployment evidence means an HTTP fallback cannot be removed solely because its existence looks unsafe; transport policy must be explicit before a compatibility-breaking build.
OSS-0026 is HOLDOUT and remains score-only: a deterministic EventSource error/empty-state mismatch was correctly treated as a narrow REPO build, with no unnecessary FIELD escalation.
